idea: Colors & shapes – colors #1 (THE SUPERMARKET, fruit aisle): a shiny red apple rolls off the fruit crate and bounces right up to Baby Ava's face ('Wow! Look! A red apple!'); chorus 'Colors, colors! Red, yellow, green!'; she shows one fruit per color – 'Red, red, red! A red apple! Yum!', 'Yellow, yellow! A yellow banana!', 'Green, green, green! A green pear!'; copy-me 'Point with me! Red! Yellow! Green!'; she asks the viewer 'Which one is yellow? Hmm?' (pause) – 'The banana! Yellow! Yay!'; lesson 'Colors everywhere I go!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now apple, banana and pear in a neat row on the crate, bye-bye wave.
lesson: Name three colors: red (apple), yellow (banana), green (pear) – colors are everywhere.
place: THE SUPERMARKET (reference supermarket.jpg) – first video in this place
calendar: Tuesday slot 1 – Colors & shapes (3 Nov was shapes; today colors red, yellow, green).
characters: BABY AVA: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby girl with short fluffy curly brown hair, one small curly ponytail on top with a sparkly pink star hair clip, big brown eyes, rosy cheeks. wearing a soft yellow dress with ruffle sleeves and a small pink flower, and pink baby shoes with bows.
setting: THE SUPERMARKET: a bright friendly supermarket with wooden crates of colorful fruits and vegetables, neat shelves, green hanging lamps, plants and a small red, yellow and blue kids' shopping cart, no brand names.

supporting_objects.fruits: THE THREE FRUITS (one plain basic color each, big, smooth and toy-like): ONE shiny bright RED apple with a little brown stem and one green leaf; ONE bright YELLOW banana; ONE bright GREEN pear with a little brown stem.

learning.goal: Name three colors: red, yellow and green.
learning.shown_how: One big fruit per color held beside Ava's face (red apple, yellow banana, green pear), then all three in a neat row on the crate, left to right in the sung order.
learning.interactive_moment: 0:19-0:21 'Which one is yellow? Hmm?' + 0:21-0:23 humming pause (question boing at 21.0) → 0:23 'The banana! Yellow! Yay!' + cheer + confetti
learning.copy_me: 0:16-0:19 'Point with me! Red! Yellow! Green!' (shot 5 pans along the row as she points)
learning.fact_check: Exactly one apple (red), one banana (yellow), one pear (green) near her in every frame; one plain basic color each; no text/price tags (a C1 background sign in shot 2 is cropped out with zoom ≥1.15). Background produce is soft-blurred.
learning.modeling: Ava names the colors happily and points; no wrong choices.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, one baby, bright calm supermarket, big face, nothing scary.

fun_mechanics: surprise hook: the red apple bounces up to her face
interactive pause: Which one is yellow?
